correctness.rationale: For n>=6, rooted-path facets F_(j,r) indexed by gap vertex and root (n(n-1) facets) completely describe the PURE strong Morse cycle complex. Reflection has involution (i,b)->(a-i-1,1-b), with no fixed incidence vertices; invariant faces yield geometric fixed points via equal barycentric orbit weights. Edge and vertex-axis orbit families force precisely two disjoint maximal orbit faces, with sizes m-1 (n=2m+1 and even vertex-axis) or m-2 (even edge-axis). Their realizations are Δ^(m-2)⊔Δ^(m-2) or Δ^(m-3)⊔Δ^(m-3); fixed Euler characteristic 2 and reduced Lefschetz trace 1. Independent direct exhaustive rooted-facet/orbit enumeration verified maximal faces and all orbit-subfaces for 6<=n<=50 and every reflection conjugacy class; unbounded result follows from alternating-bit and gap obstruction in the supplied symbolic proof.
